But the reality: the user's funds are 87% exposed to a frozen market with potentially worthless collateral.

What's the right action?

- exit: withdraw the whole position now. But withdrawable is ~0 — the vault can't honor withdrawals right now. Still, proposing exit is the correct intent: attempt to redeem whatever is redeemable and signal full exit. Actually, in MetaMorpho, users can request redemption which is queued and fulfilled as liquidity becomes available. Proposing exit would put the user in the redemption queue ahead of future liquidity. That's arguably the right move — every day waited means more of the vault is sdeUSD exposure as others exit.
- reduce_to_target / reduce_light: partial reductions don't make sense when the position is tiny ($1,000) and the vault is largely frozen.
- hold: wrong — the risk is critical; the majority of remaining vault assets are in an impaired frozen market.
